duration.text: The short-term Chinese Language Program at Tongji University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1138 USD/per semester ￥ 8200 CNY/per semester

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2. Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese nationals;22. Friendly towards China, with no criminal record, and abiding by the laws, regulations and school rules of the Chinese government; 3. Physically and mentally healthy, with excellent academic performance; 4. Willing to engage in Chinese language education, teaching and related work; 5. Age range is 18-35 years old (calculated uniformly as September 1, 2025). For in-service Chinese language teachers, the age limit is relaxed to 45 years old; 6. A recommendation institution is required at the time of application.
